'''Ranganathan Gregoire Yogeshwar''' (born 18 May 1959{{citation needed|date=July 2024}}) is a [[Luxembourg]]ish physicist and science journalist based in Germany. He started gaining attention at the end of the 1980s in the [[Geographical distribution of German speakers|German-speaking area]] for his science documentaries that were often coupled with critical analysis and prognoses of the societal effects of research in the [[natural sciences]].

==Early life and education==
Yogeshwar grew up in [[Bangalore]], India, and Luxembourg and went to primary school in both places. His father is an Indian engineer and his mother a Luxembourgish art historian.<ref name="naechste_ausfahrt">{{cite book |last1=Yogeshwar |first1=Ranga |title=Nächste Ausfahrt Zukunft: Geschichten aus einer Welt im Wandel |date=5 October 2017 |publisher=Kiepenheuer & Witsch |location=Cologne |isbn=978-3462051131 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=p7LGDgAAQBAJ |pages=125–127 |accessdate=19 June 2019 |language=de}}</ref> He has a younger sister and a twin brother, Pierre Kalyana Yogeshwar, who is also a physicist.<ref>{{cite thesis |title=Dissertation: Quanten-Hall-Effekt. Hartree-Rechnung zur Coulomb-Wechselwirkung |url=http://d-nb.info/890971641 |publisher=Technical University of Munich| language=de |last1=Yogeshwar |first1=Pierre Kalyāna }}</ref> His grandfather was mathematician and librarian [[S. R. Ranganathan]], the developer of the [[colon classification]]. Growing up, he spoke [[Luxembourgish]], German, French, English, [[Tamil language|Tamil]], [[Kannada]], [[Hindi]] and [[Malayalam]] (the latter three to communicate with his housekeeper, teacher, and gardener, respectively).<ref name="naechste_ausfahrt" /><ref>{{cite web |last1=Dohnke |first1=Kay |title=We need to change, pursue new paths |url=https://www.schaeffler-tomorrow.com/tomorrow/226/index.html |publisher=Schaeffler tomorrow |accessdate=19 June 2019 |date=April 2018}}</ref>

Yogeshwar studied music in Luxembourg and obtained his Diplôme de fin d’études secondaires (equivalent to British [[A-Levels]]) at the Lycée classique de [[Diekirch]]. He studied at the [[RWTH Aachen]] in [[Aachen]], Germany, graduating with a [[Diplom]] degree in [[experimental physics]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Vita von Ranga Yogeshwar |url=http://www.phoenix.de/vita_von_ranga_yogeshwar/17624.htm |publisher=Phoenix |accessdate=19 June 2019 |archiveurl=https://archive.today/20120909064414/http://www.phoenix.de/vita_von_ranga_yogeshwar/17624.htm |archivedate=9 September 2012|language=de}}</ref> He worked at the Swiss Institute for Nuclear Research (SIN), at [[CERN]], both in Switzerland and at the [[Forschungszentrum Jülich]] in Germany.<ref name="Vita">{{cite web |title=Vita | date=16 August 2017 |url=https://yogeshwar.de/?p=374 |accessdate=19 June 2019 |language=de}}</ref>

== Career ==
[[File:Ranga Yogeshwar Ideenexpo Spule.jpg|thumb|upright=0.85|Yogeshwar in 2011]]
In 1983, he started working in radio and television for various stations.{{citation needed|date=July 2024}} During a stay in India in 1985, he led a series of seminars and conferences, including one at the [[Indian Institute of Science]] in [[Bangalore]].{{citation needed|date=July 2024}}

Yogeshwar began to work with [[Jean Pütz]] at the [[Westdeutscher Rundfunk]] (WDR) in Cologne in 1987 as science editor. Until 1990 he hosted many episodes of the ''Wissenschaftsshow'' alongside Pütz. The WDR developed the show ''[[Quarks (TV series)|Quarks und Co.]]'' for Yogeshwar, based on the same concept as the ''Wissenschaftsshow'', and he led this show from 1993 to 2018, before handing it over to [[Mai Thi Nguyen-Kim]] and [[Ralph Caspers]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Ranga Yogeshwar gibt Moderation an Mai Thi Nguyen-Kim und Ralph Caspers weiter |url=https://www1.wdr.de/unternehmen/der-wdr/unternehmen/quarks-moderationswechsel-102.html |website=WDR |date=6 November 2018 |accessdate=19 June 2019 |language=de}}</ref> From 1989 to 1999, he co-hosted the TV show ''Kopfball''. From 1995 to 2001, he was the acting Head of the Science Programmes division of the WDR, and in 2001, he replaced Alfred Thorwarth as the head of the same division, remaining in that post till 2018.<ref name="Vita" /> Until 2002, he presented the research and environmental magazine ''Globus'' and the show ''W wie Wissen'' from 2006 to 2007 on [[ARD (broadcaster)|ARD]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Wissen vor 8: Folge 4: Crash bei Tempo 100|url=http://www.daserste.de/wissenvoracht/folge_dyn~vorschau,yes~cm.asp|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080315001254/http://www.daserste.de/wissenvoracht/folge_dyn~vorschau,yes~cm.asp|url-status=dead|archive-date=15 March 2008|website=Das Erste|accessdate=6 July 2019|language=de}}</ref> He also moderates the series of events ''Wissenschaft live'' organised by the [[Deutsches Museum Bonn]]. Yogeshwar organises parts of the kids radio show ''Lillipuz''.<ref>{{cite news|title=Warum nur manche Wollpullover kratzen| url=https://www.welt.de/print-welt/article189012/Warum-nur-manche-Wollpullover-kratzen.html| author=Ulrike Langer|publisher=Die Welt|date=6 June 2006}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Yogeshwar and his wife Uschi live with their four children in [[Hennef]] near [[Bonn]].<ref name="Vita" /><ref name="ga_bonn">{{cite news |last1=Eisner |first1=Ingo |title=Ranga Yogeshwar von "Quarks und Co" plädiert für digitalen Wandel |url=http://www.general-anzeiger-bonn.de/region/sieg-und-rhein/hennef/Ranga-Yogeshwar-von-Quarks-und-Co-pl%C3%A4diert-f%C3%BCr-digitalen-Wandel-article3803265.html |accessdate=19 June 2019 |agency=General Anzeiger Bonn |date=11 March 2018 |location=Bonn |language=de}}</ref> He is an [[atheist]].<ref name="kolner_sa">{{cite news |last1=Burgmer |first1=Anne |title=Interview mit Ranga Yogeshwar "Die Gesellschaft wird dumm gehalten" |url=https://www.ksta.de/kultur/interview-ranga-yogeshwar-die-gesellschaft-wird-dumm-gehalten-2496200 |accessdate=19 June 2019 |agency=Kölner Stadt-Anzeiger |date=29 October 2013 |language=de}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Schwyzer |first1=Andrea |title=Ranga Yogeshwar spricht über den Glauben |url=https://www.ndr.de/themenwoche/Ranga-Yogeshwar-spricht-ueber-Glauben,interviewyogeshwar100.html |agency=NDR |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170716162125/https://www.ndr.de/themenwoche/Ranga-Yogeshwar-spricht-ueber-Glauben,interviewyogeshwar100.html |archivedate=16 July 2017|language=de}}</ref>
